name: ffmpeg-video
description: Edit, assemble, caption, mix, check and render video on this computer with FFmpeg (wraps the MIT-licensed ffmpeg-skill by kajisho5). Runs only on Sophon's process sandbox backend; needs Python 3.10+ and FFmpeg/ffprobe 6.1+ installed on the host. Refuses the Docker sandbox. No network, no credentials.
